company.name: Daylight
company.shortDescription: Daylight offers affordable solar and battery solutions to help homeowners cut energy costs and take control of their power.
company.description: Daylight is the decentralized energy company, built for the people who power it. We transform everyday homes into mini power plants, helping families lower their energy bills, stay powered during outages, and earn rewards for supporting a more reliable grid. As the energy system strains to meet growing demand, Daylight sends excess energy from homes back into the system, reducing pressure on aging infrastructure and reinforcing local resilience. With seamless home upgrades, an intuitive energy management platform, and a growing decentralized network, Daylight is building the future of energy from the ground up.

productsAndServices.description: A residential energy subscription providing solar and battery storage with no upfront equipment or installation cost and a monthly rate intended to be below the customer’s utility rate.
productsAndServices.name: Daylight Energy Subscription

productsAndServices.description: An integrated residential system combining solar panels for electricity generation, a home battery for storing surplus energy and outage backup, and monitoring of home energy performance.
productsAndServices.name: Daylight Solar + Battery System

productsAndServices.description: A full-service delivery program covering system design, permitting, inspections, installation, activation, monitoring, repairs, and maintenance for Daylight home energy systems.
productsAndServices.name: Installation, Maintenance, and Support

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for viewing solar production, battery charge, home energy usage, savings, outage alerts, weather conditions, and related account information in real time.
productsAndServices.name: Daylight App

productsAndServices.description: A power purchase agreement offering for solar installers that includes battery storage as a standard part of each installation, with Daylight handling procurement, compliance, filings, and project tracking.
productsAndServices.name: Daylight Partner PPA

productsAndServices.description: A coordinated network of Daylight-equipped homes that generate, store, and share energy locally while participating in automated grid interactions.
productsAndServices.name: Distributed Energy Network
